article.title: Grants by Central Government.
article.content:
221Grants by Central Government.

Section 221  ·  Part IV · Chapter VII  ·  page 139 of the Act
The Central Government may, after due appropriation made by Parliament by law in this behalf, make to the Board grants of such sums of money as that Government may think fit for being utilised for the purposes of this Code.
